LocalStore.readmeBody:
This folder holds the conversation records OpenTandem keeps on this computer (opentandem.db).
  - Uninstalling or deleting the OpenTandem Runner does NOT delete this folder.
  - Deleting this folder by hand permanently loses the local copy, and the server cannot restore it for you.
  - Do not edit opentandem.db by hand. To back it up, copy this whole folder after quitting OpenTandem.
